name: threshold two blocks a lone source
input: one one-day source next to a healthy cell
test:
original = [[1, 0]]
assert simulate_pending_death(original, infectious_days=1, death_threshold=1, infection_threshold=2) == (1, 0, [[2, 0]])
assert original == [[1, 0]]

name: threshold two infects and immediately dooms a new cell
input: a healthy cell between two one-day infections
test:
original = [[1, 0, 1]]
assert simulate_pending_death(original, infectious_days=1, death_threshold=2, infection_threshold=2) == (2, 1, [[2, 3, 2]])
assert original == [[1, 0, 1]]

name: threshold three prevents infection before the sources recover
input: two one-day sources around one healthy cell

name: threshold one keeps doom sticky after pressure disappears
input: two-day infection where one neighbor dies earlier
test:
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 0]], infectious_days=2, death_threshold=1, infection_threshold=1) == (3, 2, [[3, 3]])
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 0]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=2, infection_threshold=1) == (2, 0, [[2, 2]])
